import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Fix species label variants
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace({'Gentto': 'Gentoo', 'Adeile': 'Adelie'})
    # Fix island label variants
    df['island'] = df['island'].replace({'biscoe': 'Biscoe'})
    # Convert flipper_length_mm from text to numeric
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    # Convert body_mass_g from text to numeric (remove commas)
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', ''), errors='coerce')
    # Fix out-of-range body_mass_g (3650000 -> likely 3650)
    df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] == 3650000, 'body_mass_g'] = 3650
    # Ensure body_mass_g is within allowed range (2500-6500)
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].clip(2500, 6500)
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by species and calculate average body mass
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    # Return as dict with species as keys
    return result
